QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Eliminate Mystic Horntail
QuestInfo.0: Professor Moon has more to say to you about the Mystic Gates.
QuestInfo.1: The professor says that a copy of Horntail called 'Mystic Horntail' might be inside a Mystic Gate. He asks you to eliminate it if you run into it.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated Mystic Horntail. You can eliminate Mystic Horntail once per day, just be sure to let Doctor Moon know afterwards. This quest is available up to 5 times a day.

0.0: According to my research, a cloned version of Horntail called Mystic Horntail appears out of this Mystic Gate. If that monster appears, the town is doomed. Please, do not let that happen.
0.1: I would assist you, but I spend this time each week applying eyelash thickener, lip plumper, and skin lightener. I also tweeze my brows, trim my bangs, and buff my nails. It's a lot of work to be camera-ready all the time, but it's part of being a pop idol.

yes.0: You may have to wait a while for Mystic Horntail to appear. The patterns emanating from that Mystic Gate are inconsistent, at best.

no.0: Team up with others, and it should be a cinch. Like astro physics.

default.0: Mystic Horntail is still a threat. You may have to wait a while for Mystic Horntail to appear. The patterns emanating from that Mystic Gate are inconsistent, at best.
